caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a human-like figure seated beside a white animal resembling a dog. The human figure has an exaggerated facial expression, is wearing a blue garment, a gray helmet or cap with a green clover on the side, yellow gloves, and pointy-toed blue shoes with yellow detailing. The figure is holding a pink bowl towards the mouth of the dog. The dog is white with pinkish inner ears, a brown collar with gold accents, and yellow feet. The dog is holding a yellow item in one paw and is positioned so that it appears to be sitting and reaching up. Both figures are seated on a green mat or base. The background of the image is plain beige. The artist's name, "Sarkis Erganian," is written in red script near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Toy Bank: "Paddy and the Pig"
